race.comment: BOWLING HARRY (12) couldn't get the job done first-up when sent out public elect but did have a slight excuse. He appears to have stronger exposed form than many of these and the inside draw gives him a solid platform second-up. CINCINNATI COBRA (6) looks the main danger. He was only fair late when fourth at this track on soft ground, but his prior Stanthorpe second reads well enough and he is set to peak third-up. NEVILLE BARTOS (13) comes off a second at this track in picnic grade and now faces harder company, yet that placing was a genuine step in the right direction after a plain Cranbourne run. HE SAYS LIES (1) just missed on debut at Warwick back in April before heading straight back to the paddock. Has been readied with just the one trial and is worth a market watch.
